prompt:
Top-down editorial still photograph. A single sheet of matte uncoated off-white paper lies flat on a seamless sun-yellow (#FFD23F) paper backdrop, slightly rotated (about 4 degrees). Hard late-morning sunlight from the upper left casts a crisp, soft-edged diagonal window-light shadow across one corner of the frame.
Printed on the sheet in clean modern sans-serif typography, near-black ink, generous margins and a clear hierarchy: an agent team step tracker, a twelve-step progress list, built in Claw Camp. Visible text, spelled exactly: "Step 1 · first agent"; "Step 6 · memory"; "Step 12 · team". Small secondary details in grey are fine but keep the three lines dominant. One small sun-yellow (#FFD23F) printed highlight on the current step "Step 6 · memory".
Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no desk, no pens, no plants, no devices, no props, no logos. Calm, minimal, high-end print photography with natural paper texture.
